regime_context: The policy regime is sequenced, inflation-gated easing: Warsh holds a strict-2% hawkish line while Bessent suppresses the front end structurally, and the Iran re-escalation has sharpened the stagflationary split. Consensus reads the Fed as simply hawkish on oil; revealed interest is that the administration wants lower real yields eventually but needs the inflation-validating optics of a hike cycle first, so the near-term trade is front-end carry and inflation-paired real assets over rate-duration.
regime_context_zh: 政策体制是按顺序推进、以通胀为门槛的宽松：Warsh 坚持严格的 2% 鹰派立场，Bessent 结构性地压低短端利率，而伊朗局势再度升级使滞胀分化加剧。市场共识把美联储简单解读为因油价而鹰派；但其所揭示的利益是：政府最终想要更低的实际利率，可眼下先需要一轮加息周期来营造通胀可控的表象，因此近期交易方向是短端息差与通胀配对型实物资产，而非利率久期资产。

theses.subject: SHV
theses.thesis: With CME FedWatch pricing >70% odds of a September hike and Warsh holding a strict-2% line, the front end offers carry plus insulation from duration risk; Bessent's bill-heavy issuance keeps short-dated supply abundant but supported. SHV vs SPY captures the low-real-yield, rate-hardening setup without depending on an equity beta.
theses.thesis_zh: CME FedWatch 对 9 月加息的定价概率超过 70%，且 Warsh 坚持严格的 2% 目标，短端既提供息差又能规避久期风险；Bessent 以国库券为主的发行使短债供给充足但受到支撑。SHV 相对 SPY 捕捉低实际利率、利率走强的格局，而不依赖股票 beta。
evidence: Fed path gap: market at 3.95 vs dot 4.1, market more dovish than the Fed
Open prediction: Fed does NOT cut at July and September 2026 meetings
Front-end Treasuries rotation theme (BIL/SHV) as FACT mechanism
theses.dissent: A labor-market crack widens enough to force a data-driven September pivot, compressing front-end yields and making SHV underperform a rallying risk complex.
theses.dissent_zh: 若劳动力市场裂口扩大，足以迫使美联储在 9 月转向数据驱动的宽松，短端收益率被压缩，SHV 将跑输上涨的风险资产。

falsifier.text: SHV lags SPY by 3% or more before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日期前，SHV 落后 SPY 达到或超过 3%

check.reason: 'SHV' not a scorable proxy (no local price series, no correlated surrogate)

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: The Iran ceasefire collapse delivered the oil spike (Brent ~$80 intraday), re-priming the Q1 2026 energy rotation. The administration's own strike posture sustains a geopolitical premium even as it wants lower real yields later, so XLE benefits from the current conflict-haven bid versus broad equity.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火破裂引发油价飙升（布伦特盘中约 80 美元），重新点燃 2026 年一季度的能源轮动。政府自身的打击姿态在地缘政治溢价持续之际又希望未来压低实际利率，因此 XLE 相对大盘受益于当前的冲突避险买盘。
evidence: Iran/Middle East theater: ceasefire COLLAPSED as of 7/8, Brent ~$80 intraday
Rotation theme: Energy (oil & gas), proxies XLE/XOP, FACT mechanism headline-fragile
Recent track: XLE overweight hit 0.0562 and 0.07 in Reflation regime
theses.dissent: A fast ceasefire or Hormuz transit normalization collapses the oil risk premium; energy reverses sharply against a risk-on equity tape.
theses.dissent_zh: 若快速停火或霍尔木兹海峡运输恢复正常，石油风险溢价崩塌，能源股将在风险偏好回暖的股市中急剧逆转。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% or more before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日期前，XLE 落后 SPY 达到或超过 5%

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: With a September hike now majority-priced and Warsh explicitly burying forward guidance, long duration is the most exposed to the rate-hardening leg. The administration suppresses the front end structurally but the long end carries hike and term-premium risk; TLT vs SPY is a rate-duration short in this regime.
theses.thesis_zh: 9 月加息已被市场多数定价，且 Warsh 明确废弃前瞻指引，长久期资产在利率走强的阶段暴露最大。政府在结构上压低短端，但长端承担加息和期限溢价风险；在当前体制下，TLT 相对 SPY 是做空利率久期。
evidence: CME FedWatch >70% probability of a Sept hike (50.6% 25bp + 19.6% 50bp)
Open prediction: Fed does NOT cut at July and September 2026 meetings
Recent track: TLT underweight hit 0.0115, TLT avoid hit 0.0126
theses.dissent: A dovish September surprise or a credibility-driven pivot on weak payrolls ignites a duration rally that punishes TLT shorts sharply.
theses.dissent_zh: 若 9 月出现鸽派意外或因疲弱就业数据引发可信度驱动的转向，将点燃久期反弹，令做空 TLT 者遭受重创。

falsifier.text: TLT beats SPY by 4% or more before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日期前，TLT 跑赢 SPY 达到或超过 4%

theses.subject: GLD
theses.thesis: Gold is trading $4,044-4,200 against a stagflationary split: hot May PCE plus an oil shock and a DXY well off its 13-month high. The administration's structural yield suppression and Iran-driven haven bid both support gold as a real-asset hedge versus equities without requiring a Mar-a-Lago dollar breakdown.
theses.thesis_zh: 黄金在 4,044 至 4,200 美元区间交易，面对滞胀分化：5 月 PCE 偏热、石油冲击以及美元指数远低于 13 个月高点。政府的结构性收益率压制和伊朗驱动的避险买盘都支撑黄金作为相对股票的实际资产对冲，而不需要 Mar-a-Lago 式的美元崩溃。
evidence: Stagflationary split: May PCE core +0.3% m/m, 3.4% y/y; headline +0.4% m/m, 4.1% y/y
Iran escalation: gold trading $4,044-4,200 range, DXY ~100.9 well off 13-mo high
Dollar/debt theater: Mar-a-Lago tail to watch, not own; low-real-yield regime gold-supportive
theses.dissent: A decisive September hike with a hawkish revised SEP strengthens the dollar and real yields enough to break gold's momentum under $4,000.
theses.dissent_zh: 若 9 月果断加息并发布鹰派修订版 SEP，美元与实际收益率走强，足以打破黄金动能并跌破 4,000 美元。

falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日期前，GLD 落后 SPY 达到或超过 5%
